text:
maya patel: Heads-up — SDRs flagged a surge of unassigned leads from the product demo CTA this morning (~5% unassigned).

drew kim: Any correlation to region or form variant?

olivia park: Looks tied to the new HS property mapping we rolled yesterday. The mapping waits on enrichment before owner set. Several enrich calls returned 504 briefly.

sam patel: Confirmed. The enrich service introduced a new external call that spikes latency when the partner API is slow. Our routing logic currently blocks assignment until enrichment completes for require_enrichment routes.

maya patel: We need a temporary change: stop gating assignment on enrichment for demo leads and assign to sales-demo-pool immediately. Enrichment can happen async and backfill owner metadata. SLA target: owner assigned < 45s.

drew kim: Proposed quick patch: set routing.campaigns.demo2026.require_enrichment=false, fallback_owner=sales-demo-pool, enrichment_async=true. Will also add an alert if unassigned_rate > 1% for 15m.

sam patel: I can push that patch and add a small guard: if enrichment latency > 7s mark enrich_async=true automatically. Also scheduling a backfill job for existing pending_enrich leads.

olivia park: Backfill query ready; will throttle to 500/sec and run during low-hours. Exported snapshot to s3://redwood-ops/exports/demo-unassigned-2356789012.csv.

infra-bot: Incident note created: MARK-556 - demo leads blocked by enrich gating. Created by sam patel.

maya patel: Thanks. Please also add a brief playbook bullet to runbook: 1) check enrich svc health, 2) flip require_enrichment flag, 3) run backfill, 4) notify SDRs.

drew kim: Patch deployed to prod after smoke tests. Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/lead-routing/demo2026

sam patel: Monitoring shows owner assignment latency dropped from median 12s to 3s for the demo route. No new errors surfaced.

maya patel: Great — will notify SDR leads and close the loop tomorrow AM with metrics. Thanks all.
